pilot.method: Actual staged production main/renderer, unpackaged Electron. Fresh prepared userData per run, seeded in an excluded process. Static 200-row local pages, independent login profiles, 30 warm selections, 3 one-second idle intervals at lazy/all-visited/closed stages. Native-ready polling <=5ms, selected UI state then double requestAnimationFrame. Summed working sets double-count shared memory; GPU metric is GPU-process CPU, not hardware utilization. One-tab warm selections are reselect controls.
